scope: Only owned horizontal flip of the two original 513x259 RGBA8/RGBA16 inputs, with sequential disposal and exact-size storage reuse. Other sizes, held-output patterns, operations and codecs remain unmeasured.
method: Managed public-call BenchmarkDotNet elapsed samples; native worker internal CLOCK_MONOTONIC intervals with owned frame materialization/release. Native pre/post means bracket managed samples; ratio uses the faster native bracket. Startup, IPC, filesystem and checks excluded on both sides.
inputProvenance: HorizontalFlipInput.Create: OriginalPixels.Generate(513,259,depth), phase zero, zero alpha at both first-row ends; hidden RGB preserved. No upstream images or corpora.
uncertainty: Conservative ratio upper estimate divides managed 99.9% Student-t upper mean by the smaller native pre/post lower mean. Native critical value comes from the managed interval, with at most the native sample count; BDN outlier removal may make it more conservative. These are per-mean statistical intervals, not a simultaneous guarantee for arbitrary images, workloads or hardware.
